conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hi, I'm Gregory, and I'm a male. I came in because I hurt my right ankle after slipping on ice yesterday. It's been swollen and painful, and I've been having trouble walking on it normally.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your age and confirm if there is any prior history of ankle injuries or conditions?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm not sure about my exact age, but I'm in my late 40s. As for prior ankle injuries, I don't think I've ever injured this specific ankle before, though I've had a lot of injuries playing soccer over the years.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the severity of the pain on a scale from 1 to 10, and have you noticed any deformity or instability in your right ankle?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain is maybe a 6 or 7 on the scale, and it definitely hurts when I touch it. I don't think there's any deformity, but it feels unstable when I try to put weight on it. I'm definitely limping.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you undergone any imaging studies or evaluations for this injury, such as X-rays or an MRI?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I haven't had any imaging studies done yet, but the doctor mentioned that the X-ray results showed no fracture. I'm not sure if there's anything else they might have done.
